# attestation policy

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attestationPolicy`](gmeow-attestationPolicy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attestationPolicy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The policy under which an attestation was issued — a value vocabulary individual naming the rules or framework the attester followed. Non-functional: competing policy interpretations coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) -> [`gmeow:AttestationPolicy`](../classes/gmeow-AttestationPolicy.md)

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md), [`gmeow:AttestationPolicy`](../classes/gmeow-AttestationPolicy.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the rules or framework the attester followed when issuing — a SLSA build level, a credential-issuance policy, an editorial standard — so consumers and the solver can weigh the attestation against its stated policy.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the attestation kind ([`gmeow:attestationType`](gmeow-attestationType.md)) and for evaluating whether the policy was actually met — that policy-evaluation outcome is a [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md) computed in the solver layer, not asserted here.

### How to use

- Reference a [`gmeow:AttestationPolicy`](../classes/gmeow-AttestationPolicy.md) individual; leave policy satisfaction to a [`gmeow:VerificationActivity`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationActivity.md) producing a [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md) (status policy-failed when unmet), and let competing policy interpretations coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### Examples

- ex:provAtt [`gmeow:attestationPolicy`](gmeow-attestationPolicy.md) ex:slsaL3.
